pairs.why: A keeps a few big quiet shapes (sky band, sand strip, calm water) with only one small ring, while B adds palm fronds, rocks, a sunny beach and busy caustic ripples that crowd the card more than the real dock card.
Both put the ball on rippled sand with dune bands behind it, and neither is clearly quieter than the other.
B keeps the real card's simple city and glass railing with no extra props, while A adds a plant, bench, tiled floor and bolted base that the real card doesn't have.
A's pi pattern is a little fainter and more tone-on-tone, like the real card, while B's pi are denser and higher in contrast.
Both use the same concentric ring field and neither has props or a busier backdrop.
B has only the striped wall and a ceiling edge like the real card, while A adds a window, curtain, plant, books and sofa that are invented props.
The wavy purple backdrop is identical in both and there are no props.
